dateConvention: Europe/Berlin calendar date; raw UTC retained
method: Only participationState=played. Calendar year uses the source calendar date (Europe/Berlin); raw UTC is retained to audit midnight boundaries. Club totals exclude invitations and club friendlies. National totals use senior internationals; British Home Championship is classified as FS by Transfermarkt but retained as the same appearances, not additional matches.
assistLimit: recordedAssists is a database field, not an exhaustive historical season total. Matthews 1955-56 currently has three recorded assists; the user's older one-assist figure is not treated as a complete count. No assist total is published.

matthews.note: 31 records carry the correct 1956 year in the PDFs.
